[[File:Tomas Bergmark portrait.jpg|thumb|right|260px|Tomas Bergmark.]]
'''Tomas Bergmark''' was a Decipher-era [[Squadron Members|Squadron Member]], listed as Red 43 from Kiruna, Sw. The slot was retired after Decipher's SWCCG run.<ref name="smlist" />

|}

Decipher recruited volunteer Squadron Members in the 1990s to promote SWCCG locally (tournaments, demos, player support).
